name: Uniwork
description: Uruguayan online store for workwear, uniforms and safety gear, plus footwear, with custom printing and embroidery. Delivers in Montevideo and ships to the interior through agencies.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de ropa de trabajo, uniformes y artículos de seguridad, además de calzado, con estampado y bordado a pedido. Entrega en Montevideo y envía al interior por agencias.

ships_to.notes: Montevideo delivery; interior orders sent to a Montevideo bus terminal and onward by an agency chosen and paid by the customer.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup at the store in the La Unión area of Montevideo.

sources.supports: Montevideo delivery, interior shipping via customer-chosen agency, store pickup
Categories, cart and checkout, own brands, nationwide shipping banner
